title: linaria multicaulis subsp. aurasiaca
intro: Linaria multicaulis subsp. aurasiaca, commonly known as the Aurasiac Toadflax, is a plant species belonging to the family Plantaginaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, helping to soothe digestive issues and reduce fever. The therapeutic actions of Linaria multicaulis subsp. aurasiaca include acting as a demulcent, astringent, and expectorant, making it useful in treating respiratory and gastrointestinal disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable resource in folk medicine.
